sql_templates.description: Retrieve sector data with breadth and stage migration.
sql_templates.name: sector_breadth_analysis
sql_templates.template:
SELECT sd.sector, sd.pct_above_50dma, sd.change_5d, s.stage, s.relative_strength, ma.stage2_pct
FROM breadth.sector_daily sd
JOIN breadth.ma_pct_above ma ON sd.snapshot_date = ma.snapshot_date
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots s ON sd.sector = s.sector
WHERE sd.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
AND s.snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
AND s.stage = 'STAGE_2'
ORDER BY sd.pct_above_50dma DESC
LIMIT 10;

synthesis_guidance: ['Focus on sectors showing improvement in breadth and stage 2 participation.', 'Ensure outputs are suitable for creating a watchlist in TradingView.', 'Rank sectors by breadth metrics and stage scores.']
title: Sector Breadth Rotation Watchlist Variant 1903

sql_templates.latest_analysis:
WITH latest_date AS (SELECT MAX(trade_date) AS max_date FROM market.index_eod),
latest_data AS (
    SELECT fii_dii_flows.trade_date, 
           fii_net_today, dii_net_today, 
           regime, confidence, 
           advances, declines, market_sentiment, 
           close AS index_close, change_pct
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    JOIN latest_date ON fii_dii_flows.trade_date = latest_date.max_date
    JOIN signals.regime_history ON signals.fii_dii_flows.trade_date = signals.regime_history.trade_date
    JOIN breadth.market_daily ON signals.fii_dii_flows.trade_date = breadth.market_daily.trade_date
    JOIN market.index_eod ON signals.fii_dii_flows.trade_date = market.index_eod.trade_date
    WHERE market.index_eod.index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT * FROM latest_data;

title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 1912

sql_templates.description: Fetch latest insider alerts and bulk/block deals with technical confirmation.
sql_templates.template:
WITH latest_snapshots AS (
    SELECT symbol, stage, stage_score, trading_signal
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
      AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
      AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
)
SELECT 
    i.symbol, i.alert_date, i.alert_type, i.entity, i.qty, i.value_cr, i.insider_score,
    b.deal_date, b.deal_type, b.qty AS deal_qty, b.price AS deal_price, b.side,
    s.stage, s.stage_score, s.trading_signal
FROM signals.insider_alerts i
JOIN signals.bulk_block_deals b ON i.symbol = b.symbol
JOIN latest_snapshots s ON i.symbol = s.symbol
WHERE i.alert_date = (SELECT MAX(alert_date) FROM signals.insider_alerts)
  AND b.deal_date = (SELECT MAX(deal_date) FROM signals.bulk_block_deals)
LIMIT 50;
